classification.rationale: Clear polyethylene bags are sacks and bags for the conveyance or packing of goods of heading 3923 and, being of a polymer of ethylene, fall in 3923.21. Without handles, a reclosable extruded closure or a very small size, the residual statistical line 3923.21.00.95 applies. NY N015142 (in force) classified unprinted polyethylene bags without handles in 3923.21.0095.
